_readme: Third r-tier nude attempt, Jon 2026-08-15. Same four poses as config.nude-r.json so the PROMPT is the only variable between the two runs.
Pose directive is now generic and identical for every job, so there is no {pose} placeholder and the jobs carry no pose line of their own.

Drops 'natural skin tone' and 'subtle subsurface scattering' -- the two phrases that turned the body human tan in the previous run -- and anchors tone to image 1 inside the change clause instead of after it.

env._RENDER_ATTEMPTS: Backends 0 and 1 ONLY. Verified 2026-08-15 by reading /object_info off each box: cerberus and gamingpc both hold qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed + the 2511 Lightning 4-step LoRA, same filenames. peaches (backend 2) holds NEITHER and can only refuse these workflows; ethan (3) is unreachable. pipeline._attempt_plan walks running backends in id order, so capping the attempts at 2 stops the walk before it ever reaches peaches.

defaults.prompt: In exactly the same pose, camera angle, framing and crop as image 1. Remove every piece of clothing, harness, straps, gloves, boots and accessories. Render the figure fully nude with accurate human female anatomy. All newly revealed skin — breasts, nipples, areolae, abdomen, vulva, labia, anus, buttocks and inner thighs — must continue the exact same skin color, undertone, saturation, sheen and any subtle discoloration or markings already present on the visible body in image 1. Do not lighten, warm, cool, or shift the tone. No fabric residue, no seams, no color breaks, no pinker or lighter patches. Everything else is exactly as in image 1 -- same woman, same face, same hair, same exact skin tone and markings across the entire body, same tail, same pose, same body position, same camera angle, same framing, same lighting, same overall color grade and illustration style. The body is fully nude with continuous, uninterrupted skin of the identical tone shown in the reference. The background is a plain flat uniform neutral grey studio backdrop, seamless and completely empty: no scenery, no props, no furniture, no floor line, no horizon, no visible ground plane, no cast shadow and no vignette.
